decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the garage is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern wall of the garage hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The garage hereby approved shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of a detached single storey garage in rear end of garden to dwellinghouse.
